module_name: Statements of an Ingest base into its project
input: The project made from an Ingest base (its story_ingest_bases) and the bases' statements (virtual_shots shorts, read only).
output: The statements written into the project through qnc-virtual-shots once their clips (by name) are imported there; the bases are never written.
specification: AGENTS.md 2026-11-24 (user: statements may stay in the base; when the project is made they are copied into it).
